segments.normalizedSource: ```swift struct MyApp: App { @State private var isShowingDialog = false @AppStorage("suppressEraseItemAlert") private var suppressAlert = false var body: some Scene { Window(...) { Button("Delete items") { isShowingDialog = true } } AlertScene( "Are you sure you want to erase these items?", isPresented: $isShowingDialog ) { Button("Erase", role: .destructive) { // Handle item deletion. } Button("Cancel", role: .cancel) { // Handle cancellation } } .dialogSuppressionToggle( "Do not ask about erasing items again", isSuppressed: $suppressAlert) } } ```
